QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Taming the Flame 3
QuestInfo.0: According to Rino, the only safe way through the Extinction Zone is on the back of a Flame Bird. Taming one, however will take a little work...
QuestInfo.1: You agree to gather 10 Hard Shells to be used as a whistle to call the Flame Bird. You can get the Hard Shell from Soulful Erdas that live in the Spirit Zone and Fire Spirit Zone.
QuestInfo.2: You gather Hard Shells from Soulful Erdas. Rino and Kao should be back by now.
